title: Victor NM-PRO-6.2KW PI30 archive and owner control report
summary: The owner identifies the unit as Victor NM-PRO-6.2KW and reports working telemetry on integration 0.1.53. The archive records QPI=PI30, shared QMN=VMII-NXPW5KW, a 25-field QPIRI response rated 6200 W / 48 V, live QPIGS, QFLAG, QMOD and firmware replies. The owner explicitly confirms Output Source Priority, Charge Source Priority and battery bulk, float, cut-off and recharge voltage changes. The read-only archive itself is not a write trace, and the report does not qualify every inherited control or uniquely identify the brand from QMN.
